title: Yellowed Nutty Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A nutty and tender Malaysian dish featuring pecorino-romano and shio-koji-cure, perfect for festive occasions. This egg-free-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the salt block to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, coriander, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together shio-koji and water.
Brush the shio-koji mixture onto the chicken strips.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Brush the salt block with vegetable oil.
Cook the chicken satay on the salt block for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Sprinkle pecorino-romano cheese over the cooked chicken satay.
Serve the Yellowed Nutty Malaysian Chicken Satay hot and enjoy.
